design_readings.design_text_quote: (+/-2%) tokens and wall-clock; matched_fields includes wall_clock_s

falsifier: Withdrawn if any pinned input hash moves; or if a re-run of the pinned harness does not reproduce the pinned report/CSV; or if check_matched_budgets is shown to test wall-clock consumption spread (AST or execution); or if the design text is amended to an envelope-only reading at a new hash that voids this pin.

findings.owner_action: design owner disambiguates envelope vs consumption; harness adds the wall-clock spread test (or the design drops the consumption clause and records the envelope-only reading) before any A2 accept
findings.statement: The pinned harness's check_matched_budgets contains no wall-clock-consumption matching test, while the pinned design pre-registers token and wall-clock matching at +/-2% (H-design). At the pin the four primary arms consumed wall_clock 30.0/30.0/24.75/24.8 (spread 17.5% of max, 8.75% of the 60 s envelope), so under the consumption reading the design's own falsifier fires and primary_comparison_valid=true is void. Under the envelope reading the clause is satisfied trivially by identical caps.

findings.owner_action: record design_ref/design_sha256 in the report and run with the design's 2% tolerance (or amend the design with a reason)
findings.statement: The pin records config.token_tolerance=0.15 (the harness default) while the design pre-registers +/-2% (0.02), and no design override/reference is recorded in the report, so budget_check.matched=true was computed against a tolerance 7.5x looser than the pre-registered one. The measured token spread (1%) passes both, so the boolean happens to agree, but the recorded check does not implement the design rule it is cited for.

findings.owner_action: optional: record command and exit code in the report
findings.statement: The pin is reproducible: an independent in-process run of the pinned harness at the pin's recorded config reproduces the report on every leaf except generated_at, and the CLI-equivalent arm runs reproduce the CSV. The pin does not itself record the command/exit code, so reproducibility rests on the README command plus the recorded generator_sha256/config.
